name: The Oaks Shopping Center
description: The Oaks Shopping Center is a premier outdoor lifestyle destination in the heart of Woodland Hills, featuring over 180 specialty shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Anchored by Macy's and a state-of-the-art 18-screen Cinemark theater, this iconic mall offers a vibrant shopping and dining experience in the San Fernando Valley. The center's distinctive oak tree-lined walkways and Mediterranean-inspired architecture create an inviting atmosphere for residents and visitors from across Los Angeles.
